Guest Journey 
Deliver seamless stays from booking to checkout.

2. Automated Messaging: configure personalized messages triggered by conditions such as length of stay, booking lead time, or channel. Send the right communication at the right moment, from booking confirmations to check-in instructions and beyond. 
 
3. Guest App: a personalized web app created for each reservation. That gives your guests all the information they need in one place, reducing questions and enhancing the overall stay experience by controlling the IoT devices in the room (smart lights, locks, A/C, ..).

Smart Operations 
Put your operations on autopilot. 

1. Multi-Calendar View: manage all listings, reservations, and cleaning schedules in one clear, consolidated calendar. 
 
2. IoT Integrations: control smart locks, climate, and energy systems, all from one place. 
 
3. Cleaning Management: automate scheduling, reduce errors, and keep teams in sync in real time. 
 
4. AI Operations Center (coming soon): proactively detect, prevent & resolve issues . 
 

Business Intelligence 
Our built-in analytics provide real-time insights into performance, pricing strategies, guest behavior, and operational trends.
